contes.name: La forêt enchantée · The enchanted forest
contes.alt: An enchanted forest clearing painted in ink and watercolor: on the left an open black iron gate leads back to the park and, beside it, the arched door of a little stone wizard's tower stands open on a spiral stair; a red-haired mermaid with a green tail sits on a mossy rock in the pond, a tiny fairy in a pink petal dress flies low over the lily pads waving a star-tipped wand, and a white unicorn licks a big ear of corn on a tree stump; in the middle a mossy rock arch opens onto a valley with a waterfall and a stone bridge; a young centaur leaps past carrying a basket of red apples, an elf plays a flute high in an old oak whose round wooden door stands open on a party lit by lanterns, a gnome in a tall red hat pushes a wheelbarrow of mushrooms, an imp in sunglasses suns himself on a red toadstool strumming a lute, a sprite with a yellow farfalle bow tie swings on a bluebell, and a bearded dwarf with a lantern bites into a big round naan.

doors.label: La vallée des géants
doors.hint: Through the mossy rock arch to the valley of giants

doors.label: La tour du sorcier
doors.hint: Through the open arched door into the wizard's tower

doors.label: Le bal costumé
doors.hint: Through the round door in the old oak to the costume ball

vallee_geants.name: La vallée des géants · The valley of giants
vallee_geants.alt: A sunny valley of giants in ink and watercolor: on the left a mossy rock arch leads back to the enchanted forest beside a waterfall, and below it, in the meadow at the bottom left, a stone castle gateway stands open on a glimpse of the castle courtyard; a red-and-gold phoenix glides across the sky and a griffin rests on a high crag; a kindly bearded giant sits on a boulder with a blue jay on his thumb; a mossy troll stands waist-deep in the stream by a stone footbridge and waves; a friendly ogre with small tusks sits on a log reading a picture book to three mice; and in front a green dragon wearing a daisy chain sleeps smiling on the grass.

doors.label: La forêt enchantée
doors.hint: Back through the mossy rock arch to the enchanted forest

doors.label: La cour du château
doors.hint: Through the stone castle gateway in the meadow into the castle courtyard

tour_sorcier.name: La tour du sorcier · The wizard's tower
tour_sorcier.alt: The round stone study at the bottom of a wizard's tower, painted in ink and watercolor under a starry blue ceiling: on the left a tall arched wooden door stands open onto the sunny enchanted forest; a young witch in a purple pointed hat sweeps the plank floor with a straw broom while her black cat trots beside it; a pink potion fizzes with heart-shaped bubbles in a round glass flask on a little table by the window; a spiral stone stair climbs to a wooden landing where a magician in a top hat and red waistcoat holds up a white rabbit next to a grinning spell book on a lectern blowing a kiss; in the middle a toy drone hovers over a big black cauldron bubbling green on a log fire; an old white-bearded wizard in a starry blue robe throws up his arms and cheers; and on the right an enchanter in a green velvet robe plays a golden tuba whose swirl of sparkles sorts the teacups onto a high wooden ledge.

doors.label: La forêt enchantée
doors.hint: Back out through the arched tower door to the enchanted forest

bal_costume.name: Le bal costumé · The costume ball
bal_costume.alt: A costume party inside a great hollow oak, painted in ink and watercolor under bunting and paper lanterns: on the left a round wooden door stands open onto the sunny enchanted forest beside a table with a birthday cake; a kneeling mother in a purple dress hugs her little girl dressed as a mummy in white bandages; on a raised wooden stage a child vampire in a high-collared cape peers out of a short cardboard van, a child in a white ghost sheet sits on a purple cushion reading a big book and fanning herself with a paper fan, and a child orc with green face paint flexes his arms; on the dance floor a boy in a grey werewolf costume hops with both feet in the air, a boy goblin with pointy ears is about to gobble a slice of cake from his plate, and a fluffy purple monster with googly eyes dances.

doors.label: La forêt enchantée
doors.hint: Back out through the round oak door to the enchanted forest

cour_chateau.name: La cour du château · The castle courtyard
cour_chateau.alt: The sunny inner courtyard of a fairy-tale castle in ink and watercolor, with pale stone towers under pointed blue roofs: on the left a tall arched gateway stands open onto the valley of giants and its waterfall; at the back the keep's big oak double door stands open at the top of wide steps, showing the great hall inside. Monsieur Verbe the mime plays fairy-tale tricks all over the courtyard: in a red beret he hands a little golden harp to baby twins singing in their cradle; in a gold beret he holds an umbrella over a young queen who peers into a crystal ball with a tiny rain cloud inside; in another gold beret he shakes his fist from his lawnmower at a deer munching the roses; in a green beret he balances a silver tray with a pigeon on it while he listens in on a princess whispering a secret; in a red beret he blows a trick trumpet that shoots a paper streamer at a startled herald; in a red beret he sweeps his hands apart as a pie appears in sparkles on a little table; in a gold beret he varnishes an old treasure chest until it looks new; in a red beret, his own beret dripping wet, he sprinkles a goose with a watering can by the birdbath; and in front, in a red beret, he kneels to offer a glass slipper on a velvet cushion to a girl in a blue dress.

doors.label: La vallée des géants
doors.hint: Back out through the arched castle gateway to the valley of giants

doors.label: La grande salle
doors.hint: Up the steps and through the open keep door into the great hall

grande_salle.name: La grande salle · The great hall
grande_salle.alt: The great hall of a fairy-tale castle in ink and watercolor, with red and blue banners and a big stone fireplace shaped like a little castle: on the left a tall arched oak door stands open onto the sunny castle courtyard. Monsieur Verbe the mime acts out tales all round the hall: in a gold beret he draws back a red curtain to peek at a white peacock fanning its tail; in another gold beret he holds a wrapped blue present to his ear, eyes closed; in a red beret at the open window he raises his arms to a puffy cloud with a cheeky face that blows his scarf; in a green beret he sprinkles green dust on a pear in the fruit bowl and it grows green fur; by the fire, in a gold beret, he opens a big storybook and a little sailing ship sails out on a blue wave; in a red beret, with a lace tablecloth over his head, he plays a pretend ghost beside his smiling auntie, who knits in her armchair; on the rug, in a red beret, he winds a golden music box for a little crowd of spellbound hedgehogs; and in front, in a red beret, joke glasses and a fake nose, he tiptoes past a sleeping dog to the cookie jar.

doors.label: La cour du château
doors.hint: Back out through the arched oak door to the castle courtyard
